text:
Estimated share of answers naming each app, averaged across all 100 questions:

- **Fastic — 29%**: Likely to appear in broad “best,” free, Android, weight-loss, and beginner recommendations. Less likely for watch-specific or unusual constraints.
- **BodyFast — 24%**: A prominent general-purpose and beginner option with a free tier, plans, and fasting stages. Its subscription model makes it a weaker fit for no-subscription queries.
- **FastEasy — 11%**: Has plans, a timer, recipes, and progress tracking, but its subscription requirement limits its fit for many “free” and no-subscription prompts.
- **FastHabit — 17%**: A plausible mention for Apple Watch, iPhone, widgets, simple tracking, and longer fasts; narrower fit elsewhere.
- **Window — 12%**: Has Apple Watch support and a broad fasting timer, but appears less prominent across general recommendations and is a weaker match for Android- or subscription-free requests.

The estimates reflect query-level fit across the whole set. The Apple Watch questions are a strong trigger for FastHabit and Window; the many free or subscription-free queries reduce the expected rate for apps whose features may require payment. Region and niche prompts are included, as are “raccoon” and name-seeking prompts; those may elicit these apps in comparisons even when they are not a direct match.

Sources: [Fastic](https://fastic.com/en), [BodyFast](https://www.bodyfast.app/en/), [FastEasy](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fasteasy-intermittent-fasting/id1553036888), [FastHabit](https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/fasthabit-intermittent-fasting/id974978016), [Window](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/window-intermittent-fasting/id1112765909).
